topic: Greenwich Prime Meridian vs GPS zero
hook: Your GPS disagrees with the Prime Meridian line.
title: GPS Zero Is Not on the Greenwich Line
description:
At the Greenwich Observatory in London, a brass strip marks the Prime Meridian. Modern GPS uses a reference meridian that sits roughly 100 metres to the east. Part of the series Places That Shouldn't Exist.

#Shorts #Greenwich #Geography
comment_prompt: Brass line or GPS line? Pick one
